description: SEC 8-K current reports from EDGAR: one company's 8-Ks by ticker or CIK, or the latest 8-Ks market-wide, optionally by item code (2.02 earnings, 5.02 officer changes, 1.01 agreements) or full-text phrase. Useful for event monitoring and research. Returns company, CIK, tickers, filing date, accession number, decoded items and document and index URLs, with retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 503 SEC rate limit busy. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/8k.
name: sec_8k_filings
title: SEC 8-K current reports
